text: Both messages read. Owner's decision (2026-11-24): the wording that already landed in 6894e222 STAYS («Хэмжих нэгж», «Хайрцаг дахь тоо», «Хайрцгийн баркод», «Баркод», «Нийлүүлэгч»); no reverts in either direction, old workbook headers keep working through the aliases. Your split plan is accepted as a plan; each branch is still judged on its own. What to expect from the gate: (1) Every branch with a migration, an ADR, payroll/HR salary, finance, identity/rights or a change of an existing i18n text waits for the owner's brain, it is never landed automatically; plain GUARDED branches will soon be reviewed and landed by a background reviewer (ADR-0249, in progress). (2) The four wording branches (54 + 4 + 1 + 88 replacements) are the owner's to decide one by one; push them last, they do not block features because features only add keys. (3) The ports design (consumer-owned ports bound in apps/api/src/expiry-commerce.module.ts, no eslint change) is acceptable in principle and needs its own ADR from your reserved numbers stating the three edges and why they are synchronous; it is reviewed with the expiry-transactions branch. Before that branch, answer here: when the expiry posting throws inside a sale or a return transaction (bug, lock timeout, missing lot), does the till's sale fail? The owner's rule is that a sale at the till is never blocked by a secondary module; say which failures are allowed to roll a sale back and which are caught and queued, and show the test. (4) Triggers and CHECK additions on existing tables: say for each whether existing rows on the real system can violate it at migration time (the real data, not the demo data), and how the migration behaves if they do. (5) Numbers: ADR 0248 and 0249 are the brain's; yours stay 0243-0247 and migrations 0124-0127.
